mapper.sql: SELECT p.*,m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id=p.merchant_account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_idempotency_locks(idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{key}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO payment_records(order_id, payment_number, idempotency_key, amount, status, failure_reason, created_at, merchant_account_id, channel, currency, request_fingerprint, channel_transaction_no, paid_at, expires_at, updated_at, checkout_url, action_type, qr_payload, version, refunded_amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{paymentNumber}, #{key}, #{amount}, 'PENDING', '', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{merchantId}, #{channel}, #{currency}, #{fingerprint}, #{channelTransactionNo}, NULL, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{checkoutUrl}, 'REDIRECT', NULL, 0, 0)

INSERT INTO payment_process_managers(process_id, order_id, process_type, status, command_id, command_fingerprint, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, result_deadline_at, next_check_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{processId}, #{orderId}, 'PAYMENT_CREATE', 'WAITING_RESULT', #{commandId}, #{fingerprint}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL '5' MINUTE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL '5' MINUTE, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO payment_command_outbox(command_id, process_id, order_id, command_type, payload_fingerprint, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, result_deadline_at, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, created_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{processId}, #{orderId}, 'AWAIT_CHANNEL_RESULT', #{fingerprint}, #{payload}, 'IN_FLIGHT', 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL '5' MINUTE, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: WHERE p.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND after_sale_id IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE refund_number=#{refundNumber} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, created_at FROM refund_events WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_records SET status='CLOSED', failure_reason=#{reason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE id=#{paymentId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE payment_command_outbox SET status='ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at=COALESCE(acknowledged_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), last_error=NULL WHERE process_id IN (SELECT process_id FROM payment_process_managers WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND process_type='PAYMENT_CREATE') AND status IN ('NEW', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'RETRY', 'DEAD')

UPDATE payment_process_managers SET status='COMPLETED', last_error=NULL, completed_at=COALESCE(completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND process_type='PAYMENT_CREATE' AND status<>'COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT processing_status, payload_digest FROM payment_notifications WHERE channel=#{channel} AND notification_id=#{notificationId}
SELECT processing_status, payload_digest FROM refund_notifications WHERE channel=#{channel} AND notification_id=#{notificationId}
SELECT r.*, p.payment_number, p.channel AS payment_channel FROM refund_records r JOIN payment_records p ON p.id=r.payment_id WHERE r.refund_number=#{refundNumber}

SELECT process_id, order_id, status, process_type, command_id, result_deadline_at, last_error, recovered_by, recovery_reason, recovered_at FROM payment_process_managers WHERE status IN ('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPENSATION_REQUIRED') ORDER BY updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_process_managers SET status='WAITING_RESULT', result_deadline_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL '5' MINUTE, next_check_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), recovered_by=#{operator}, recovery_reason=#{reason}, recovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE process_id=#{processId} AND status IN ('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPENSATION_REQUIRED')
UPDATE payment_command_outbox SET status='RETRY', attempts=attempts+1, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), last_error=NULL WHERE process_id=#{processId}

UPDATE payment_process_managers SET status='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', last_error='RESULT_TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE status='WAITING_RESULT' AND result_deadline_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint, processing_status FROM payment_result_inbox WHERE result_id=#{resultId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_process_managers SET status=#{status}, last_error=#{error}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE process_id=#{processId}
UPDATE payment_process_managers SET status='COMPLETED', completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE process_id=#{processId}
UPDATE payment_command_outbox SET status='ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE process_id=#{processId}
UPDATE payment_records SET status='SUCCESS', failure_reason='', paid_at=COALESCE(paid_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE id=#{paymentId}
UPDATE payment_records SET status=#{status}, failure_reason=#{reason}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE id=#{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE refund_number=#{refundNumber} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_records SET status=#{status}, channel_refund_no=COALESCE(channel_refund_no, #{channelRefundNo}), failure_reason=#{reason}, succeeded_at=CASE WHEN #{succeeded} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE succeeded_at END, failed_at=CASE WHEN #{failedTimestamp} THEN failed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE id=#{refundId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_result_inbox(result_id, process_id, order_id, result_type, outcome, payload_fingerprint, payload, processing_status, error_detail, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, received_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{processId}, #{orderId}, #{resultType}, #{outcome}, #{fingerprint}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{error}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO payment_notifications(payment_id, channel, notification_id, channel_transaction_no, signature_valid, processing_status, payload_digest, failure_reason, received_at, processed_at, raw_status, retry_count, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{channel}, #{notificationId}, #{channelTransactionNo}, TRUE, #{status}, #{digest}, #{failure}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{channelStatus}, 0, NULL)

INSERT INTO refund_notifications(refund_id, channel, notification_id, channel_refund_no, signature_valid, processing_status, payload_digest, failure_reason, received_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{channel}, #{notificationId}, #{channelRefundNo}, TRUE, #{status}, #{digest}, #{failure}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO payment_outbox(event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, published_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, , 'NEW', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO payment_remote_message_inbox(message_id, message_kind, payload_fingerprint, processing_status) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{fingerprint}, 'RECEIVED') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint, response_payload FROM payment_remote_message_inbox WHERE message_id=#{id}
SELECT id, merchant_no FROM payment_merchant_accounts WHERE channel=#{channel} AND enabled=TRUE
SELECT process_id FROM payment_process_managers WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('WAITING_RESULT', 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_events(payment_id, event_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{aggregateId}, #{eventId}, #{type}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO refund_events(refund_id, event_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{aggregateId}, #{eventId}, #{type}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
